requirements.quote: Bidders/proposers for this contract for commodities, services or technology are strongly encouraged and expected to consider SDVOBs in the fulfillment of the requirements of the contract.
requirements.text: Bidders are encouraged to involve SDVOBs in fulfilling contract requirements.

requirements.quote: Such partnering may be a subcontractors, suppliers, protégés or other supporting roles.
requirements.text: Partnerships with SDVOBs can include roles like subcontractors, suppliers, or protégés.

requirements.quote: SDVOBs can be readily identified on the directory of certified businesses at: http://ogs.ny.gov/Core/docs/CertifiedNYS_SDVOB.pdf.
requirements.text: SDVOBs can be identified using the provided directory link.
